attributes.action: To reinstate the use of Ventolin (Salbutomol) Inhalers to asthmatics.
attributes.additional_details:
Maintenance and Reliever Therapy (MART) is an asthma treatment plan where you use one combination inhaler instead of two separate preventer and reliever inhalers.
A MART inhaler has been shown to lower the risk of asthma symptoms and attacks.

This may well be the case in a lot of circumstances, however limiting people to just one blue inhaler as a back up plan does not help the asthmatic if shortness of breath or an attack occurs. 
The blue Ventolin inhaler is vital and should not be removed.
attributes.background:
To reinstate the decision of the removal of the blue Ventolin (Salbutamol) inhaler. 
Many asthma sufferers have now been advised to use a combination of medication under the Maintenance and Reliever Therapy (MART) plan, where you use one combination inhaler instead putting people’s lives at risk.

rejection.details: The prescribing of asthma medicines is a clinical matter, guided by healthcare professionals and national clinical guidance.
